h1: Ananya Lipe Resort — a beachfront resort on Pattaya Beach a minute's walk from Walking Street
intro: If location is what matters most to you on Koh Lipe, Ananya Lipe Resort sits in a spot that's hard to beat — right on Pattaya Beach, the island's finest white-sand front beach, and roughly a 1-minute walk from Walking Street with all its restaurants and bars. Opened in 2019, it's still relatively new, with two outdoor pools, pool-access rooms you can step straight into the water from, and sea-view jacuzzi suites. It's made for travellers who want a beautiful beach and the convenience of having everything in walking distance. From approx. THB 4,800/night · 9.0 from 359 reviews.

body.html: Pattaya Beach is Koh Lipe's front beach — where the ferries and speedboats land, with fine white sand, clear water, and most of the island's restaurants and bars. Ananya Lipe Resort sits right on it, with its own stretch of white sand out front and Walking Street, the heart of the island, just about a minute's walk away. This is the place for people who want sea views and convenience in one spot, with no hill climbs or longtail transfers like many of the resorts over on the Sunrise side.

The resort opened in 2019, so it still feels fresh, with around 67 rooms across several tiers. It starts with the Deluxe Regency Wing (41 sqm), a modern standard room with a comfortable bed, and moves up to Pool Access rooms (42 sqm) that open straight onto the water. Higher up are jacuzzi suites — the Honeymoon Sea View Suite (82 sqm), Family Jacuzzi Suite (120 sqm), and the Royal Jacuzzi Pool Suite Sea View (183 sqm). Guests repeatedly praise the spacious, clean rooms and quality bedding — a step above the average on Pattaya Beach.
"Stepped off the boat and we were at the resort in a few minutes. Clean room, very comfy bed, morning swim in the pool, then a short walk out to Walking Street for dinner — easy in the best way."

What sets Ananya apart from the island's smaller guesthouses is the breadth of facilities — two outdoor pools with a pool bar, a spa, a fitness centre, and several in-house restaurants: Pattaya Restaurant, the beachside Ananya Sandbar, a Steak House and Sugoi Teppanyaki for Japanese. Guests often single out the steaks and cocktails at the Steak House, and the beach bar at sunset. The breakfast buffet scores around 8.6 — solid for an island resort where supplies have to come a long way.

Worth knowing before you book: because it's beside Walking Street and has a beach bar, rooms near the beach or at the front can pick up music and night-time buzz. If you're a light sleeper or travelling with small children, ask for a room set further back or on an upper floor. The upside of a lively location is that everything to eat and drink is within a short walk — but it does trade away the quiet of the resorts at the far ends of the beaches.

Other honest notes from the reviews: front-desk service can be inconsistent — most guests find staff warm and helpful, but a few report slow or indifferent responses when it's busy. A handful of reviews also mention some maintenance or refurbishment work and a few areas showing wear. And, as with everywhere on Koh Lipe, getting here means a speedboat from Pak Bara or Tammalang piers (Satun), about 1.5 hours, with airport transfers running around THB 1,400.

The overall score is around 9.0 from 359 reviews on Trip.com · Hotels.com about 9.4 · Expedia about 9.2 · with the location score reaching 9.6, which is very high — confirming that the resort's real strength is its walk-to-everything Pattaya Beach setting. In short: if you want a newer beachfront resort with good rooms, pools and restaurants, a minute from Walking Street, Ananya is one of the most well-rounded picks on Pattaya Beach. But if you're chasing quiet, private seclusion in nature, a resort at the far end of Sunrise Beach may suit you better.

A tip from reading the reviews: for a honeymoon or for more privacy and sea views, it's worth moving up to a Jacuzzi Suite or Pool Access room — the experience is a noticeable step up over the standard rooms. And book early in high season, because well-located resorts like this on Koh Lipe fill up fast.

honestSummary: Ananya Lipe Resort is best for travellers who put location and convenience first — right on white-sand Pattaya Beach, a minute's walk to Walking Street, with newer clean rooms, two pools and several in-house restaurants. But accept that it's a lively setting: front rooms hear the beach bar at night, and front-desk service can be inconsistent — it isn't the resort for anyone chasing quiet, private seclusion.

If you want quiet and honeymoon-style privacy — this sits in the middle of the island's buzz → choose an upper/inner-facing Jacuzzi Suite with sea view, or consider a far-Sunrise-Beach resort in this series.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Ananya Lipe Resort

faq.q: Where is Ananya Lipe Resort and how do you get there?
faq.a: It sits right on Pattaya Beach, Koh Lipe's front beach, in Satun province, about a 1-minute walk from Walking Street. Reaching Koh Lipe means a speedboat from Pak Bara or Tammalang pier (Satun), about 1.5 hours, landing on Pattaya Beach in front of the resort. Sunrise Beach and Sunset Beach are both around a 10-minute walk away.

faq.q: What are the room prices and types at Ananya Lipe Resort?
faq.a: Rates start at approx. THB 4,800/night for the Deluxe Regency Wing (41 sqm) in normal periods. Above that are Pool Access rooms (42 sqm), the Honeymoon Sea View Jacuzzi Suite (82 sqm), and the Royal Jacuzzi Pool Suite Sea View (183 sqm) at THB 16,000+. In high season (Nov–Apr) prices climb sharply, often above THB 7,000 — compare platforms and book ahead.

faq.q: Who is Ananya Lipe Resort best for?
faq.a: It's best for travellers who want a newer beachfront resort with good rooms and walk-to-everything convenience — two pools, pool-access rooms and several in-house restaurants. It's less suited to those seeking quiet, private seclusion in nature, since it sits in the middle of the island's buzz.

faq.q: Is Ananya Lipe Resort noisy, and which room should I request?
faq.a: Because it's beside Walking Street with a beach bar, rooms near the beach or at the front can hear music at night. If you're a light sleeper or with small children, ask for a room set further back or on an upper floor and note this when booking.

faq.q: Does Ananya Lipe Resort have pools and restaurants?
faq.a: Yes — two outdoor pools with a pool bar, and some room types are Pool Access, opening straight onto the water. For dining there are several in-house venues: Pattaya Restaurant, the beachside Ananya Sandbar, a Steak House and Sugoi Teppanyaki for Japanese. The breakfast buffet scores around 8.6.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book?
faq.a: High season on Koh Lipe runs November to April, when rooms fill quickly and prices rise, so book 2–3 months ahead — especially for a well-located Pattaya Beach resort like this. In low season (monsoon), many island resorts close, so check first. Pick a Free Cancellation rate if your plans aren't firm.
